jobs.description:
Are you ready to unlock your potential? At Straumann Group we’re on an exciting journey of growth, innovation, and impact - driven by our mission to improve oral health and transform millions of lives worldwide. United by purpose, we bring our best selves to work every day, embracing a high-performance, player-learner culture that inspires collaboration, curiosity, and ambition. Here, you’ll have the opportunity to take charge of your own career, harnessing your skills, passion, and enthusiasm for learning to continually grow and progress. Together, we’re not just shaping brighter smiles, we’re unlocking the potential of people everywhere, including our own. The global dental industry is evolving rapidly. As dental practices increasingly join larger networks and Dental Service Organizations (DSOs), new opportunities are emerging to transform how oral healthcare is delivered. At Straumann Group, our Global Enterprise Solutions team builds long-term strategic partnerships with leading DSOs worldwide, bringing together our comprehensive portfolio of dental solutions, technologies, and services to help our partners grow and deliver better patient outcomes. The Global Head of DSO Education Services plays a pivotal role in defining and executing a cohesive global educational service strategy that’s robust, standardized, repeatable and scalable for our DSO customer target group. This individual will create and execute a clinical excellence strategy to establish Straumann Group as the partner of choice for clinical excellence in the field of Surgical Implantology, Restorative, Orthodontics and Digital Dentistry. Your role Set the strategy and value proposition - Define and champion the Enterprise Education vision, value proposition and global strategy, addressing the talent and capability challenges facing DSOs - Develop short- and long-term strategies to scale and commercialise education across clinical, business and leadership domains. - Translate DSO needs into differentiated propositions for C-suite leaders, providers, practice teams and platform teams. Build the education architecture and customer offer - Create learning pathways that connect clinical excellence with business performance, leadership capability and effective team practice. - Develop customer segmentation and tiering strategies that make the offer relevant to different DSO needs and maturity levels. - Design scalable education concepts that combine in-person, digital and blended formats, working with the Education Architecture & Design team to ensure effective and efficient delivery. - Ensure the offer reflects the breadth of the Straumann Group portfolio, including digital solutions and new launches. Create a scalable delivery and commercial model - Establish frameworks, processes and governance needed to design, contract, deliver and continuously improve education programmes for DSO customers. - Develop scalable delivery models especially focussed on in person/live patient training - Define how LMS platforms and other learning technologies can improve the customer experience and support future integration with top-tier customers. - Partner with regional and country organisations across NAM, EMEA and APAC to implement the global strategy while adapting delivery to local needs. Shape the offer with customers and internal partners - Build strong relationships with DSO C-suite stakeholders, including Chief Medical Officers and CCOs across top- and mid-tier customers, to understand needs and shape relevant solutions. - Partner with the Consulting team to connect business education pathways with DSO network assessments and broader transformation priorities. - Work closely with Business Units and ITI to represent Enterprise needs and adapt relevant content for DSO environments. - Collaborate across Enterprise Solutions to keep education content current, portfolio-complete and aligned with customer priorities. Enable the organisation to deliver - Define the capabilities and training requirements for internal Clinical Education Specialists (CES), including course content, training materials and web-based learning. - Equip regional and country teams to deliver the proposition consistently through clear frameworks, tools, training and implementation guidance. - Act as an internal advocate for Enterprise Education, building awareness and alignment across Straumann Group functions and markets. - Develop and manage Enterprise Key Opinion Leader relationships in support of the global education strategy. Measure impact and improve performance - Establish education KPIs and reporting at global, regional, customer and programme levels. - Track adoption, learner experience and capability outcomes, and use evidence to refine the offer and demonstrate value to customers and the business. 
• Your profile 
• What you bring - Bachelor’s degree in education, business, healthcare or a related field, or equivalent experience. - 7+ years of experience in enterprise education, services, business development or programme management. - Proven ability to design and scale capability programmes or lead complex programmes from strategy through delivery. - Understanding of clinical education and how it connects to business, leadership and workforce needs. - Experience leading global, cross-functional initiatives and engaging senior stakeholders. Nice to haves Experience working in clinical processes in implantology, restorative and Orthodontics departments. This role operates our hybrid working model 60% presence in office, 40% flexible working. Regular travel (30- 40%) is required. What makes you a great fit? You can combine strategic thinking with a focus on execution and are conformable navigating changing priorities in complex environments with an entrepreneurial mindset. You are comfortable building trusted relationships across cross-functional business groups. You are collaborative and take ownership of outcomes and use customer insights to improve solutions.

Le groupe regroupe des marques mondiales et internationales synonymes d’excellence, d’innovation et de qualité, notamment Straumann, Neodent, Anthogyr, Medentika, ClearCorrect, Dental Wings ainsi que d’autres entreprises et partenaires détenus totalement ou partiellement. Avec plus de 8 000 employés dans le monde, le Groupe développe, fabrique et fournit des implants dentaires, des instruments, des biomatériaux, des prothèses CADCAM, des équipements numériques, des logiciels et des aligneurs transparents pour des applications en dentisterie de remplacement, restauratrice, orthodontique et préventive. En tant que fournisseur de solutions globales, nous adoptons une approche holistique, offrant formation, assistance et une large gamme de services aux praticiens dentaires, cliniques et laboratoires à travers le monde. Il gruppo riunisce marchi globali e internazionali che sono sinonimo di eccellenza, innovazione e qualità, tra cui Straumann, Neodent, Anthogyr, Medentika, ClearCorrect, Dental Wings e altre aziende e partner interamente o parzialmente di proprietà. Con oltre 8.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo, il Gruppo sviluppa, produce e fornisce impianti dentali, strumenti, biomateriali, protesi CADCAM, apparecchiature digitali, software e rivestimenti trasparenti per applicazioni in odontoiatria sostitutiva, restauratore, odontoiatria ortodontica e preventiva. Come fornitore globale di soluzioni, prendiamo un approccio olistico, offrendo formazione, assistenza e una vasta gamma di servizi a professionisti dentali, cliniche e laboratori in tutto il mondo. Principali compiti e responsabilità: - Serie di parti tecniche di lavorazione con macchine moderne - Riparazione di componenti meccanici - Manutenzione e rilevamento di guasti Competenze e conoscenze professionali - Sei curioso, motivato e pronto ad imparare - Ti piace armeggiare o capire come funziona tutto. - No. Vuoi un lavoro dove ti muovi, produci, ripara e impara

descriptionByLocale.en:
STRAUMANN GROUP The Straumann Group combines global reach, experience and innovation with passion and commitment to irreproachable quality, making improved dental care available and accessible to clients and patients worldwide. The group brings together global and international brands that are synonymous with excellence, innovation and quality, including Straumann, Neodent, Anthogyr, Medentika, ClearCorrect, Dental Wings and other companies and partners that are wholly or partially owned. With more than 8,000 employees worldwide, the Group develops, manufactures and supplies dental implants, instruments, biomaterials, CADCAM prostheses, digital equipment, software and transparent lineers for applications in replacement dentistry, restorer, orthodontic and preventive dentistry. As a global solution provider, we take a holistic approach, offering training, assistance and a wide range of services to dental practitioners, clinics and laboratories around the world. Main tasks and responsibilities: - Machining technical parts series with modern machines - Repair of mechanical components - Facility maintenance and fault detection Skills and professional knowledge - You're curious, motivated and ready to learn - You like to tinker or understand how everything works. - You want a job where you move, manufacture, repair and learn
• What we offer: - Comprehensive training with professionals - An exciting profession in a meaningful field - A great atmosphere and real prospects for the future All qualified candidates will be considered for employment regardless of race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin or disability.
descriptionByLocale.de: STRAUMANN-GRUPPE Die Straumann-Gruppe verbindet globale Reichweite, Erfahrung und Innovation mit Leidenschaft und Engagement für einwandfreie Qualität und macht eine verbesserte zahnärztliche Versorgung für Kunden und Patienten weltweit zugänglich. Die Gruppe vereint globale und internationale Marken, die für Exzellenz, Innovation und Qualität stehen, darunter Straumann, Neodent, Anthogyr, Medentika, ClearCorrect, Dental Wings und andere Unternehmen und Partner, die ganz oder teilweise im Besitz sind. The Straumann Group has been one of the most innovative companies in Switzerland for more than 70 years. Our employees work every day to further develop dentistry. We develop, manufacture and supply dental implants, CAD/CAM prosthetics and biomaterials that help people to live better around the world. In more than 100 countries, we work together on new, forward-looking solutions, combining technology, innovation and teamwork. At our headquarters in the Jacob-Burckhardt building directly next to the SBB station in Basel, we currently train 11 apprentices in 6 different professions. You start your apprenticeship at our location in Basel. After opening our new Technology and Innovation Center in Arlesheim, you will continue your education in a state-of-the-art work environment. The change of location offers you the opportunity to become part of an innovative environment and to continue your professional development in a modern infrastructure. During your four-year training, you will gain exciting insights into the diverse world of visual design and can actively contribute your creativity. You get to know the entire range of design and work on varied projects – from corporate identity to web design and text design to audio and video productions as well as 2D and 3D applications. With us, you take on responsibility early on and can implement your own smaller projects independently. Your ideas and your work are not only appreciated in the team, but can also be presented and exhibited within the company or externally. Your profile - Good school degree (at least secondary school level E) - Pre-course in design required (already completed or currently ongoing) - Creative and solution-oriented thinking - Interest in design, digital media and new technologies - Exact, structured and careful working methods - Self-employment and willingness to take responsibility - Good manners and pleasure in working together in a team - High reliability and motivation - Good English skills
• This is what we offer you - A practical, varied and versatile training - Personal and competent support by experienced professionals and practical trainees - Exchange and joint activities with other learners - An international working environment with colleagues from all over the world - Opportunity for professional training - An open and collegial corporate culture - Modern and bright workplaces with current infrastructure - 6 weeks holidays and other attractive benefits Interested? Then we look forward to your full application via our career page until spring 2027. Your application should contain the following documents: - Letter of motivation - CV - Copies of certificates - Portfolio and proof of the preliminary course in design (already completed or currently ongoing). If you have any questions, Julia Hemmer, HR Shared Services Specialist and Training Manager, will be happy to contact you.
